summary: Houdin's internal-spiral-ramp theory (external ramp for bottom ~30%, internal ramp above) remains unproven and is criticized by Egyptologists as 'far-fetched and horribly complicated'.
content: Houdin's thesis remains unproven and in 2007, Egyptologist David Jeffreys from University College London described the internal spiral hypothesis as 'far-fetched and horribly complicated', while Oxford University's John Baines declared he was 'suspicious of any theory that seeks to explain only how the Great Pyramid was built'.
